greeting.message: Back already? What do you need?

scouts-status.message: They're still here, still waiting for better equipment. But morale is holding. My people are tough - they just need the right tools to do their jobs.

responses.text: What kind of equipment do they need?

equipment.message: Protection, mostly. Good armor, sturdy weapons, maybe some magical items if the foundry can spare them. The wilderness isn't kind to the unprepared.

responses.text: I'll see what I can do.

exploration-advice.message: The first rule of exploration: always have an escape plan. The second rule: never go alone. The third rule: bring more supplies than you think you need. Follow those, and you'll have a better chance of coming back.

experience.message: I've lost good people out there. People who didn't follow those rules - or couldn't. That's why we're staying put until we're properly equipped. I won't lose anyone else to carelessness.

check-in.message: Well, we're still here. Still waiting. But I appreciate you checking on us. Means you actually care about keeping my scouts alive.
